claim_boundary: fresh bounded natural-language branch-and-merge transfer through a label-free path ensemble; no open-domain, frontier-reasoning, or serving authority

corpus.language_and_domain_contract: all domain nouns, register aliases, clause order, and surface constructions are disjoint from the natural source, development, alias-source, identity-source, and CP1102 replication inventories
corpus.value_contract: fresh deterministic integer and integer-sequence values generated only after this preregistration is committed

arm_contract.selector_inputs: only executable IR availability and signed path provenance
arm_contract.forced_incumbent_lesion: decode both paths and replace the selector decision with incumbent without changing either path
arm_contract.challenger_evidence_absent_lesion: decode both paths and set challenger executable-IR evidence to zero before the unchanged selector
arm_contract.ordinary_decode_contract: same resident checkpoint and public request text, one greedy response, one final-integer parse, no verifier feedback and no retries
